Strength is graded by the frame rather than binary: the same bigram with a 15+ token lead-in or a full reference line peaks ~0.6-2.2 above the ~0.56 active line, the identical words as a bare 1-2 sentence fragment peak only ~0.25-0.50 and count as INACTIVE, and the same characters outside the bigram stay near zero (~0-0.2): clock-time, shopping-list and news-label colons (10:45, Groceries:, Jackpot winner:), decimal points (3.75), spaced score hyphens (3 - 2), the hyphen itself in prefix or compound joins (re-, anti-, LPS-, long-running, well-known, first-choice), ordinary list commas and sentence-final periods, thing-sense looks itself, full-word have for clitic 've (0.46, below line), object him/his, tag-inversion he (didn't he?), and the noun after determiner that (that box).
